title: Sentinel Advanced Military Solutions deep dossier for private review

selectedGap.reason: Sentinel AMS is a Canadian defence systems integrator with a broad public portfolio spanning deployable infrastructure, point-of-need manufacturing, power, and UAS or counter-UAS systems, but it is absent from the published and pending corpus.

guardrailNotes: This dossier is a private review candidate only and does not modify published organizations, capabilities, sources, evidence, mission matches, relationships, or demand records.
LinkedIn established useful discovery trails for named CANSEC systems, but only durable Sentinel, CMP, and CADSI pages are used as promoted field evidence.
No contract, customer deployment, readiness level, or technical specification is inferred where the official portfolio does not provide one.

candidates.reviewerRationale: Sentinel Advanced Military Solutions is recommended for amber private review because official and independent public evidence establishes a current Canadian defence systems integrator with an unusually broad, relevant portfolio. Sentinel's own pages support five distinct capability families: the Star Forge deployable ecosystem, point-of-need manufacturing and digital stockpiles, modular command and support enclosures, hybrid power, and layered UAS or counter-UAS systems. CMP's official pages corroborate the Châteauguay manufacturing base and parent-company industrial capacity, while CADSI lists Sentinel as a new CANSEC 2026 exhibitor and states that exhibitors are Canadian-registered private-sector member companies with active Canadian operations. The reviewer should verify whether Sentinel is separately incorporated or is a CMP operating brand, and should not add the more specific LinkedIn-discovered names StarForge DTIN, ForgeX, ForgeExtreme, or LARS until durable product or government evidence is available. Those gaps limit completeness, not the inclusion case.
reviewWarnings: No separate Sentinel legal entity was resolved; official privacy and terms pages identify CMP as the site operator, so legalName remains null and the parent relationship should be reviewed.
Specific CANSEC names such as StarForge DTIN, ForgeX, ForgeExtreme, and LARS were found through LinkedIn discovery only and are deliberately excluded from promoted capability facts.
The public portfolio provides no customer deployments, contracts, detailed technical specifications, or readiness levels for the proposed capability families.

duplicateCheck.note: Live production checks found no published organization, active pending candidate, or proposed capability slug matching Sentinel Advanced Military Solutions, Sentinel AMS, sentinel-ams.com, or the five proposed capability records. A local normalized-name comparison across all 114 live organizations found no plausible fuzzy duplicate.

fieldEvidence.excerpt: Sentinel identifies itself as a defence-focused systems integrator within the CMP Group that delivers modular, deployable infrastructure for distributed operations, force protection, and expeditionary use.
CMP's official contact page lists the shared Quebec headquarters and manufacturing campus at 1241 Rue Cascades, Châteauguay, Quebec J6J 4Z2.

Sentinel describes itself as CMP Group's strategic expansion into defence and security-focused systems integration, supporting the proposed parent relationship without assuming a separate legal entity.
The Sentinel-domain privacy policy supplies a public CMP email and Quebec telephone number, while the Sentinel site provides a public partnership and capability contact form.
CADSI lists Sentinel Advanced Military Solutions as a new indoor CANSEC 2026 exhibitor at booth 4312, providing independent evidence of current Canadian defence-sector activity.
The official portfolio supports the five proposed capability families but does not publish customer deployments, contract awards, detailed specifications, or readiness levels for them.
Sentinel calls Star Forge its flagship deployable defence ecosystem and says it combines edge manufacturing, secure digital stockpiles, modular enclosures, power, and UAS or counter-UAS protection.

Because Star Forge combines tactical data or communications infrastructure with deployable power and manufacturing, it has a moderate analyst-derived fit to resilient processing and decision support near operational users.
Sentinel describes deployable additive manufacturing that replaces some physical inventory with secure digital stockpiles for point-of-need production of mission-critical components.
The official portfolio lists modular enclosures for command-and-control nodes, maintenance facilities, drone docking or launch systems, and tactical data or communications hubs.
Deployable command, tactical data, and communications nodes can house processing and communications close to operators, supporting a moderate derived edge-data-processing alignment.
Sentinel says it integrates hybrid power architectures intended for quieter operation, energy independence, and sustained deployment without fixed infrastructure.
Sentinel states that it develops and integrates layered unmanned and counter-unmanned systems covering detect, track, identify, and neutralize functions.
The documented integration of unmanned systems and detect-track-identify functions supports a moderate analyst-derived alignment to autonomous patrol and monitoring workflows.
Sentinel says it operates within CMP Group and is backed by CMP Advanced Mechanical Solutions' manufacturing scale, quality systems, and electro-mechanical expertise.
CADSI states that all CANSEC exhibitors are association members; its exhibitor directory separately lists Sentinel Advanced Military Solutions as a 2026 participant.
